description: Calculates a saved model as it stands, with the same engine as the browser builder: ownership after every event for a cap table, proceeds by holder for a waterfall (at the saved exit, or up to 10 exitValuations you pass), a fund's lifetime totals plus the fund by year (granularity "quarter" or "none" to change that), or a forecast's outputs, the same as its compute tool. For a fund, workbook true adds a 24-hour link to the live Excel workbook; that needs the Venture Capital Model, the same as the browser's Excel export, and workbookOptions chooses what it includes. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

exitValuations.description: Waterfall only: sale prices to run, up to 10.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder), "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model), or "unit-economics", "saas-forecasting", "ecommerce-forecasting" (the web models with the same names as their compute tools).

workbook.description: Fund only: add a link to the live Excel workbook.

workbookOptions.description: Fund only: what the workbook includes. true adds a block, false leaves it out. A feature the fund uses (preferredReturn, clawback, recycling) is always in. Unset, it matches the model's last export from the web, or leaves out features the fund does not use and keeps every sheet.

name: run_saved_model
title: Run a saved model
